hypotheses.title: Breakeven Asymmetry 10-Day Velocity & Structural Level Dominance
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Direct optimization of Batch 151 Candidate 2 (46ec7888, which achieved Sharpe 1.14 and Sub-universe Sharpe 1.03 with zero self-correlation). While the raw 5-day delta generated excess turnover (40.59%) dampening Fitness, extending the differencing window to 10 days (ts_delta(ratio, 10)) and elevating the persistent structural level weight to 75% filters microstructure noise while capturing multi-week dealer inventory adjustments. This contracts turnover to the 18%-22% sweet spot, directly multiplying the Fitness metric toward the Gold Consultant threshold.
confounders: Abrupt implied volatility shifts around quarterly earnings announcements
Options expiration gamma pin-risk distorting strike breakevens
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if 10-day breakeven adjustments lag sudden market-wide volatility regime transitions.

candidates.expression: 0.75 * group_rank((ts_backfill(call_breakeven_20, 60) - close) / (close - ts_backfill(put_breakeven_20, 60) + 0.01 * close), subindustry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_delta((ts_backfill(call_breakeven_20, 60) - close) / (close - ts_backfill(put_breakeven_20, 60) + 0.01 * close), 10), subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: 75% structural 20-day breakeven level + 25% smoothed 10-day velocity with 5-day price reversal buffer

hypotheses.title: Breakeven Asymmetry 20-Day Percentile Rank Channel Breakout
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Replaces discrete differencing with continuous 20-day time-series percentile ranking (ts_rank(ratio, 20)). Bounded strictly between 0 and 1, ts_rank measures where current dealer call room relative to put support sits within its own monthly historical channel. This isolates equities experiencing institutional upside gamma breakouts without injecting high-frequency turnover spikes.
confounders: Prolonged range-bound market consolidation where percentiles drift without volume support
Illiquid option chains with wide bid-ask spreads
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if options open interest fails to adjust dynamically over 20-day trading cycles.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * group_rank((ts_backfill(call_breakeven_20, 60) - close) / (close - ts_backfill(put_breakeven_20, 60) + 0.01 * close), subindustry) + 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank((ts_backfill(call_breakeven_20, 60) - close) / (close - ts_backfill(put_breakeven_20, 60) + 0.01 * close), 20), subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Blended 20-day breakeven level and 20-day time-series percentile rank breakout

hypotheses.title: Breakeven Skew Term Structure Steepener (20d vs 60d Asymmetry Spread)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits the term structure of institutional dealer skew by measuring the spread between 20-day front-month breakeven asymmetry and 60-day back-month asymmetry (ratio_20 - ratio_60). A widening spread reflects aggressive front-month institutional call accumulation relative to longer-dated positioning, creating a persistent, low-turnover directional impulse that is completely unmined on the platform.
confounders: Earnings cluster events concentrated in specific sectors
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if front-month and back-month implied skew move in locked synchronization across market cycles.
